newsitem.title: USA: Car too small to carry suspected burglars' loot.
newsitem.headline: Car too small to carry suspected burglars' loot.

text.p: Two suspected burglars were nabbed when police spotted a safe sticking out of the back of their loaded getaway car, authorities said Tuesday.
Richard and Raymond Lingle of Sioux Falls were stopped by police Saturday night and were later charged in connection with the burglary of a local business earlier that evening.
The haul included the safe, darts, pool cues and other games equipment -- but it didn't all fit into the trunk of the Lingles' Honda Prelude.
